answer: Proof of Stake (PoS) serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By requiring agents to lock capital, the network enforces a cost-to-attack proportional to their influence. Like the sturdy walnut shell protecting a kernel, economic stakes harden the system against malicious proliferation. If an attacker attempts to flood the network, they face devaluation as severe as the brittle willow bending under stress. Quartz oscillators in validators ensure time-based finality, making identity fraud prohibitively expensive.
